انقشعت (form VII)

# اِنْقَشَعْتَ (inqašaʕta) /in.qa.ʃaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# اِنْقَشَعْتِ (inqašaʕti) /in.qa.ʃaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# اِنْقَشَعَتْ (inqašaʕat) /in.qa.ʃa.ʕat/: third-person
